transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I just haven’t had much push lately. I used to go to choir, do my quilting, visit folks some. Now most days I’m just home with the TV on low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Do you still enjoy the activities you used to do, like quilting and choir, when you do them?

Not like I used to. If I get there, I can sit through it, maybe do a little… but I don’t feel that same pull for choir or quilting anymore. Mostly I just stay home, TV on low, even when I know I’m supposed to be somewhere.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I’m not sure. I don’t know if I’d call it sad, exactly… I just feel kind of quiet, I guess.
Do you find pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Not really. I mean… choir and quilting used to feel good to me, and visiting folks too. Now I just don’t have much push for any of it. I mostly stay home with the TV on low, even when I know people are waiting on me.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don’t think so… I haven’t really been keeping track, but my clothes seem about the same.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless about things?
I don’t know… not really worthless. I guess I feel bad sometimes, but I don’t think about it much.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to, or have trouble getting started on things?

I guess… I have trouble getting started more than anything. I don’t have the push I used to, for choir or quilting or going to see folks. Most days I just sit home with the TV low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been thinking about hurting myself.
How long have you been feeling this way, without much push to do things?
I guess it’s been… a little over two years. Since I retired from the school office, it’s just sort of built up.
Do you often think about death?
Not really… I mean, I know I’m older, so it comes to mind now and then. But I don’t sit around thinking on death a lot.
Have you noticed any difference in your energy levels over the past two years?
Yes… I think so. I just don’t have the same push I used to. Things like choir, quilting, visiting people… I mostly stay home with the TV on low, even when I know folks are expecting me.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where your lack of push to do things was much worse than it is now?

I don’t think there’s been a big dip, no. It’s more just been the same kind of… no push. I keep not going to choir or quilting, don’t visit much. Most days I’m just home with the TV low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Would you say that there are times when your lack of interest in activities and feeling quiet are so bad that you can't take care of your daily needs?

No… not like that, I don’t think. I can still manage my day-to-day things. It’s more I just don’t feel like going out much… choir, quilting, seeing folks. I end up staying home with the TV low, even when I know they’re expecting me.
Have you had any times in the last two years where you felt so low or quiet that you couldn't get out of bed?
No… I don’t think it’s been like not getting out of bed. I just don’t have much push to go do things—choir or quilting, visiting folks. I end up staying home with the TV low most days.
Have you had any times in the last two years where you felt so low that you wished you wouldn't wake up?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve felt quiet, but not like wishing I wouldn’t wake up.
Have you had any times in the last two years where you felt so low or quiet that you couldn't do the things you needed to do at home?

No… I can do what needs doing at home. It’s more that I don’t have the push for things like choir or quilting, or visiting people. I just stay in with the TV on low, even when I know folks are expecting me.
Do you ever find any activities that give you pleasure?
Not much lately. I used to like choir and quilting, seeing people… but I don’t really get myself to go. Mostly I just sit home with the TV low.
Have you felt like your lack of interest in activities and feeling quiet have interfered with your relationships with family and friends?
A little, yes. I… I stepped back from leading choir and helping with some senior-center things. I wasn’t keeping up with what I said I’d do. Some church friends check on me more now.
Would you say that your lack of interest in activities and feeling quiet have caused significant distress or problems in your daily life?

Yes… I guess it has caused some problems. I had to step back from leading choir and helping with things at the senior center because I wasn’t keeping up with what I’d promised. And… some church friends check on me more now than they used to.
Would you say your lack of interest in activities and feeling quiet are affecting your life most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes… most days, I’d say. I don’t have the push for choir or quilting or going to visit folks. I mostly stay home with the TV low, even when I know people are expecting me.
